title: A Bowtie-Wearing Goat’s Thank You
excerpt: Five years into my BowtieGOAT ventures and two years into this Substack, I am humbled and blessed for all of your support.
content:
Five years into my BowtieGOAT ventures and two years into this Substack, I am humbled and blessed for all of your support. Believe it or not, I started my YouTube channel to prove to my then 9-year-old son that YouTube was not a viable career choice. Today, that channel has passed 5,000 total subscribers, and my face has appeared for more than 7,700 hours this year on YouTube, which is frightening! Some of those early videos deserve to be remade (I’m looking at you, DECA Role Play Tips). I think DECA will be changing role plays after this year, so I think that video will get remade anyway!

Two years ago, I started this Substack as a way to reach advisors in a more detailed format. I never really intended to set up a paid tier, but it was an option when I established this site. Then, some of you signed up for a paid subscription.

As a thank you to the paid subscribers, I want to get you all a book and send it your way with a few other BowtieGOAT goodies. The book this year is First Impressions: How to Speak So People Listen by Praveena Mahendran, DECA’s Western Region Vice President. Whether you keep the book yourself or pass it along to a student, it is a tremendous read and supports a young leader who has devoted many years to DECA. Passing this book along to you is my way to say thank you for supporting me. And, I like using your support to boost others in DECA.

If you are a yearly paid subscriber or are a monthly subscriber for three consecutive months, please complete the form below the break.

For free subscribers, I see you too. Thank you for your subscriptions. I am impressed anyone reads my random musings and DECA support online. As teachers, we don’t have much disposable income. I will keep posting free content to support everyone on their DECA success journeys!
